คิวเบก

The letter 'Q' as spoken in the ICAO phonetic alphabet, used in ATC phraseology for identification of taxiways, holding points, and aircraft callsigns.

Definition

The letter 'Q' as spoken in the ICAO phonetic alphabet, used in ATC phraseology for identification of taxiways, holding points, and aircraft callsigns.

Operational example
